related.description: # Vim's text-objects-ish for zsh (obsolete for zsh-5.0.8)
Jump quickly to directories that you have visited "frecently." A native Zsh port of z.sh with added features.
#zsh automatic complete-word and list-choices. Originally incr-0.2.zsh  by y.fujii <y-fujii at mimosa-pudica.net>
All the motions you could ask for and more for Zsh's vi mode.
